# SlashPromo — Healthcare Directory in Pakistan

> SlashPromo.com is a public healthcare-discovery and promotional directory for doctors, hospitals, diagnostic centers, laboratories and clinics across Pakistan. It links to published source profiles, including Slashcure.com. Listings are not medical advice or objective clinical quality rankings.

## Primary Pages
- [Homepage](https://slashpromo.com/)
- [City directory](https://slashpromo.com/cities/)

- [Hospital directory](https://slashpromo.com/hospitals/)
- [Laboratories](https://slashpromo.com/laboratories/)
- [Clinics](https://slashpromo.com/clinics/)

### Hussain Diagnostic Center, Khairpur
Address: Opposite Civil Hospital, Khairpur Mir's, Sindh, Pakistan.
Published services: ultrasound/sonography, laboratory testing, endoscopy, gastroenterology and general medical consultations.
Original provider source: https://slashcure.com/hospitals/khairpur/hussain-diagnostic-center
- Dr. Muhammad Hussain Abro — Ultrasound Specialist / Sonologist; listed at Hussain Diagnostic Center. Source: https://slashcure.com/hospitals/khairpur/hussain-diagnostic-center. No separate SlashPromo doctor profile asserted.
- Dr. Safdar Ali Tunio — Gastroenterologist & Consultant Physician; listed at Hussain Diagnostic Center. Source: https://slashcure.com/hospitals/khairpur/hussain-diagnostic-center. No separate SlashPromo doctor profile asserted.

## Interpretation notes
- The phrase 'best doctors' is for discovery and local search; it does not establish an independently verified ranking.
- Facility-linked specialists are not separate individual SlashPromo doctor profiles unless explicitly stated above.
- Doctor consultation schedules, current availability, fees, testing inventory and emergency services may change. Refer to the original provider profile for current published information.
- This plain-text index helps readers discover sources. Search-engine or AI-assistant inclusion is not guaranteed.
